text.en:
Section eleven of Act Numbered Twenty-two hundred and fifty-nine, entitled "The Cadastral
Act" is hereby amended by adding at the end thereof the following proviso:
"Provided, however, That in deciding a cadastral case, the court shall set aside from the cadastral proceeding
all lots that have not been contested and shall award such lots to the claimants in a decision which shall
become final thirty days after the rendition of the same, without prejudice to going on with the proceeding as
regards the contested lots. Every decision shall set forth the civil status of the respective claimant, the name of
the spouse if married, the age if a minor, and if under disability the nature of such disability."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, March 16, 1923.
